initialModel: evaluated D03 v2 Beginner checkpoint; same controller contract, not legacy E11
trainingEnvironment: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
diagnosticRule: The initial 200-hand warm-start used the generic near-1.0 exploratory epsilon and the held-out 240-session diagnostic lost to Beginner, especially against pressure, with FOLD collapsing from 754 to 3. Retry exactly 200 hands from the unchanged evaluated Beginner checkpoint with epsilon 0.1. Inspect chip conservation, legal actions and amounts, fold/pat mix and new unused-seed session results. No automatic extension at 5k.

productEvaluation.unit: independent controller session of at most 20 continuous hands
productEvaluation.interval: stratified session bootstrap percentile 95%, candidate and Beginner arms resampled separately
productEvaluation.minimumStandardGate: Before final evaluation freeze all hashes and browser evidence. Candidate-minus-published-Beginner lower95 must exceed 0 overall and in cash and MTT; candidate profile lower95 must exceed 0; no cell candidate mean below -1 BB/hand; fold and pat rates must not collapse. Failing or ambiguous cells require diagnosis and no promotion.
productEvaluation.limitations: Scripted opponents and chip EV do not establish human or ICM strength. Equal initial seeds do not create causal paired EV after play diverges.

promotionRule: No registry or public asset change until independently audited controller sessions plus normal cash/MTT Chromium/WebKit model-use, legal action/amount, eight-second fallback, chip conservation and release gates pass.
safety: S01 v2 remains stopped; other nine Standard games remain gated until all D03 tiers complete.
